vb_textbox.text: There are 4 different gnomes in the game and the mushrooms you will get from each will change as the game progresses. At first experiment with each of them to find the ones that will give you the most mushrooms and stick to them until the number of mushrooms you get reduce to 3 or 4. When this happens try picking the other 2 gnomes to see if they offer more mushrooms compared to the ones you picked at the start of the game. If they do then stick to those gnomes until it is time to switch again. Try to be quick with your decision so you don't lose on mushrooms.
